question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Sanguine
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pessimistic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sanguine"** means optimistic, hopeful, or cheerful, especially in difficult situations. (आशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **Even after facing repeated failures, she remained sanguine about her future success.
 

 
• **"Pessimistic" **refers to a tendency to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen; it is the opposite of being sanguine. (निराशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **His pessimistic outlook made him doubt the success of the project even before it began.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sanguine' **is **'pessimistic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pessimistic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Optimistic **(आशावादी): Having a positive outlook and believing that good things will happen.

 
 
• **Example:** She has an optimistic attitude towards life, always seeing the brighter side of things.
 

 
• **Cheerful **(प्रसन्न): Being noticeably happy and positive.

 
 
• **Example: **His cheerful demeanor lifted everyone's spirits during the meeting.
 

 
• **Hopeful **(आशान्वित): Feeling or inspiring optimism about a future event.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the challenges, she remained hopeful about achieving her goals.
